reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: accrue_interest has 7+ non-test callers in market.move (L274, L459, L578, L647, L884, L901, L919). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in scope; attack entry is untrusted public borrow. Gate 3: reserve.move is explicitly in scope and the issue is interest rate manipulation (listed focus area). Code confirms: accrue_interest (L125-149) increases cash_reserve by reserve_factor*interest without asserting cash >= cash_reserve.ceil(); borrow_amount (L197) computes self.cash - self.cash_reserve.ceil() as unsigned, which aborts on underflow in Move; withdraw_underlying (L313) asserts cash >= cash_reserve.ceil() post-withdrawal. An attacker can trigger this via the public borrow entry point by borrowing near-maximum liquidity across multiple accounts, causing sustained interest accrual to push cash_reserve.ceil() above cash, freezing all subsequent withdrawals and borrows for all market users.
